ABOUT ME & VALUES

Curious mind, practical builder.

A Computer Science student driven by continuous learning, collaborative problem solving, and building digital tools that matter.

I am currently a Computer Science student at Vietnam-Korea University of Information and Communication Technology (VKU). My journey in technology centers on practical execution—learning concepts by applying them in team projects, competitions, and research initiatives.

Throughout my academic studies, I have actively participated in national and university technical competitions, from front-to-back web systems (Zengaku) to assistive AI models for vocational guidance (Color Blindness Assistant) and cross-platform mobile care apps (AI Aging Care).

I deeply value team collaboration, methodical problem scoping, and understanding how different layers of a system connect—from user requirements and accessible UI/UX design to robust database queries and backend implementation.
